turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
Take your time.
I borrowed five hundred pounds from a payday lender for Arjun's party and I hate myself for it.
What went through your mind then?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. It is not easy to talk about.
And how was that for you?
Dave helped me install blocking software on my phone and laptop.
What happened next?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. I keep coming back to it.
How did that feel for you?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
Take your time.
I called the gambling helpline and talked to a man named Dave for forty minutes.
Mm-hm. Go on.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
How did that feel for you?
I lie awake at night calculating how long it would take to pay everything back.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I think so, yes.
What happened next?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
